# Chapter 12 — Connectivity, SCC, and Condensation

## APIs
- `weakly_connected_components(g)`
- `strongly_connected_components(g)`
- `condensation_graph(g)`
- `condensation_graph_from_scc(g, scc)`
- `validate_condensation_graph_detailed(...)`

## Output
- SCC component map.
- Condensation DAG.
- Edge witnesses linking original graph to condensation edges.
